ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Investigations: A Web of Corruption?
ideas.description: Investigating the connections between various fraud allegations and investigations in Minnesota
ideas.angle: Following the money and exploring connections between entities and officials
questions: What are the connections between Minnesota Governor Walz and Mayor Frey's investigations?
How widespread is child care fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and abuse of power in Minnesota, and explore the connections between various entities and officials.
